about: docs/MEDIA.md describes this file. Put each file beside it and list it under its slot.

slots.title: A Terminal Under the Stars
slots.caption: Slow 20 s orbit from the showcase camera: screens glow against the night sea and light your face. Then a still from shot 1.
slots.where: Costa del Sol, the beach below the villa, Eastern La Noscea.

slots.title: The Drop from Above
slots.caption: The glass dropdown sliding down, switching tabs with the icon bar, closing again. A still with the tab bar in focus.
slots.where: Aftcastle, facing the harbour, Limsa Lominsa Upper Decks.

slots.title: Last Call at the Drowning Wench
slots.caption: Over-the-shoulder still: pets glowing among the lanterns. A second still mid bell ripple (/term bell aura).
slots.where: The Drowning Wench terrace, lanterns behind you, Limsa Lominsa Upper Decks.

slots.title: The Arcanist's Tome
slots.caption: Character draws the glowing device, taps while you type, puts it away on close.
slots.where: Arcanists' Guild, by the reading tables, Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks.

slots.title: Dockside Construction
slots.caption: Pick up a screen, carry it through the air, snap it onto the dock wall, resize to fit. 25 s.
slots.where: Moraby Drydocks, the pier beside the aetheryte, Lower La Noscea.

slots.title: Golden Hour at Summerford
slots.caption: Run down the path with pets trailing and settling, then click the pinned screen: the character walks up and it floats out to meet you.
slots.where: Summerford Farms, the path between the fields, Middle La Noscea.

slots.title: Light in the Grotto
slots.caption: Walk behind the pillar so the screen hides behind the rock and your character stays in front; the screen's light on the cave wall.
slots.where: Seasong Grotto, inside the cave mouth, Middle La Noscea.

slots.title: Circling Aleport
slots.caption: Two screens orbiting you at sunset while the camera pulls back. 15 s.
slots.where: The cliffs above Aleport, sea behind, Western La Noscea.

slots.title: Storm Warning
slots.caption: Screens tinted by the rain; pull a mob and the screens derez in scanlines, then return when combat ends.
slots.where: Near the Moraby Bay coast, low-level mobs, Lower La Noscea.

slots.title: Into the Screen
slots.caption: Double-click the screen: it flies to the centre of the view; double-click again to send it back.
slots.where: Anywhere with a pinned screen at eye height, Limsa Lominsa Upper Decks.

slots.title: A Home Office in Mist
slots.caption: A still of a wall of terminals at night; a second with shadows on if they render.
slots.where: A quiet plot's garden wall (after the quest Where the Heart Is (Mist)), Mist.

slots.title: Five Bells
slots.caption: All five bell styles rippling from your character in turn, captions included.
slots.where: Moraby Drydocks plaza at night, Lower La Noscea.

slots.title: Every Terminal at a Glance
slots.caption: Crop of the toolbar with the popup listing every terminal.
slots.where: Aetheryte Plaza (HUD visible), Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks.

slots.title: Make It Yours
slots.caption: One still per tab, same window size.

slots.title: Ask the Almanac
slots.caption: A pet terminal opens with the question, the answer streams in, the agent board shows progress.
slots.where: Aftcastle bench, Limsa Lominsa Upper Decks.

slots.title: Couch Mode
slots.caption: Tap Create to open, hold to step through terminals, double-tap to step back, with a controller overlay if possible.

video.title: Ghostty for FFXIV: the tour
video.length: about 75 s, 1080p60, music optional, no voice
video.caption: The homepage video, cut from the clips below.

cuts.note: Open on the night beach, screens glowing. Title: Ghostty for FFXIV.
Ctrl+` drops the glass terminal over Limsa. Caption: Eorzea is a terminal multiplexer.
Carry a screen and snap it to the dock. Caption: put screens anywhere.
Pets trail you; click one and walk up to it.
Your character works a glowing device while you type.
Ask your local assistant from inside the game.
Pull back to the beach. End card: the source repository and the vote link.
